decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system is closely related to the firm's long-standing spraying equipment knowledge and its continued website presence across 2023 and 2024 suggests enough learning and market fit to justify retention.

The low-pressure injection pump builds directly on the firm's core pump capabilities, had its own product page in both years, and the reported field-testing history indicates strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialise it.
The low-pressure material transfer pump reuses proven WIWA air motors, showing high relatedness to existing knowledge and a good basis for incremental improvement rather than withdrawal.

Fire protection flow monitoring appears somewhat less central to the firm's traditional machinery base, so despite being maintained on its own page in both years it carries a higher risk of discontinuation if learning and sales remain limited.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is very close to the firm's established spraying technology base, and although it is newer and only visible in 2024 that same relatedness makes continued development more likely than exit.
